title: Senior Seminar
description: Provides enrichment of the core curriculum of the Veterinary Technology Program. Students will focus on senior year time management. They will reflect on the summer study guides and continue to identify best practices for studying. They will participate in weekly instructor-guided study sessions covering their core curriculum courses this quarter. They will also develop study techniques that will assist them in being successful in future quarters. Intended for students in the Veterinary Technology Program; enrollment is limited to students accepted in the program.
outcomes: Discuss and participate in a variety of self-care activities.
Evaluate how privilege, equity and inclusion come to play within the veterinary field.
objectives: Balance life, work, and school schedules for senior year
Discuss challenges students may face in the veterinary field
content: Conversations with difficult clients, coworkers, and supervisors
